AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Star-Blessed Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] enjoyed an extraordinary childhood, most notably through what seemed like celestial favor. For inexplicable reasons, ships carrying [PAWN_pronoun] consistently completed voyages with unprecedented smoothness, making [PAWN_nameDef] the Navigation Department's most prized passenger.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Unknown Pioneer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Whether from childish curiosity or thirst for knowledge, [PAWN_nameDef] undoubtedly possesses a heart yearning for the unknown. This explorer's spirit drives [PAWN_pronoun] to seek profound mysteries rather than remain in safe comfort zones.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Little Wanderer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Due to a gravity generator malfunction, [PAWN_nameDef] spent an unforgettable childhood hour floating midair. Though bewildered by the medical team's frantic examinations afterward, that magical "flight" experience became permanently etched in [PAWN_nameDef]'s heart.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Spaceport Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As a "special" spaceport native, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up convinced [PAWN_pronoun] was destined to join the Navigation Department. This innate sense of mission makes [PAWN_nameDef] hold [PAWN_pronoun]self to high standards - even when tempted by terrestrial wonders, [PAWN_pronoun] resists boarding shuttles... unless no acquaintances are aboard.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Junior Technician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Growing up aboard a spaceport, [PAWN_nameDef] easily befriended navigation crews who half-seriously taught [PAWN_pronoun] professional knowledge. Through this exposure, [PAWN_nameDef] genuinely absorbed some spaceship expertise - if only a little.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Brave Little Rescuer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: "Explore! Rescue! Protect!" Though unsure where this motto originated, [PAWN_nameDef] embraces it wholeheartedly. These words became [PAWN_pronoun]'s childhood creed and enduring ideal. To [PAWN_nameDef], adventure and protection share equal priority.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·“Master of Space Exploration”
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Though the source remains mysterious, [PAWN_nameDef] firmly believes [PAWN_pronoun] will become a great explorer. Through skepticism and encouragement alike, [PAWN_nameDef]'s stubborn perseverance gradually turned doubters into silent well-wishers.\n\nPerhaps someday we'll witness the "[PAWN_nameDef]" making history.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The World's Little Analyst
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] views life as one grand question, and [PAWN_pronoun]'s purpose is finding answers. To collect data, young [PAWN_nameDef] traveled across star systems, visiting imperial cities to study diverse lifestyles.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Interstellar Lemming
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: "Oh! What's that!" Yes, [PAWN_nameDef] is marveling again. Perhaps innately curious, [PAWN_pronoun] finds wonder in the most mundane novelties. This endless amazement sends [PAWN_nameDef] journeying like a lemming - while others grow weary, [PAWN_pronoun] remains endlessly delighted.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Gentle Messenger
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Whether due to cuteness or quiet demeanor, little [PAWN_nameDef] became the palace attendants' most cherished child. Through their doting, [PAWN_nameDef] learned the warmth of "affection" and "gentleness," now clumsily yet sincerely trying to share these feelings with others.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Navigation Department Pilot
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: "Do you know where [PAWN_nameDef] is?" "In the astrometrics room." This isn't a joke but an accurate summary of [PAWN_nameDef]'s routine. Though the Navigation Department has the empire's finest navigation systems, emergencies happen. Driven by love for ships and duty to crewmates, [PAWN_nameDef] stands ever ready to face the most perilous voyages.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Beacon Keeper
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] maintains a spaceport's navigation beacons. The work may seem mundane, but it profoundly impacts countless ships' fates. While most don't understand its importance, every returning crewmember leaves notes on [PAWN_nameDef]'s door: "You remain as vital as Polaris today."

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Route Strategist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: An interstellar empire's shipping lanes require meticulous planning, and [PAWN_nameDef] helps maintain this grand network. Though most routes are established, constant changes demand new designs and retirements - all requiring [PAWN_nameDef]'s expertise and official notifications.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Emergency Dispatcher
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: All are equal, but transit rights aren't - especially for rescue and supply ships risking everything. When these vessels dock, specialists like [PAWN_nameDef] prioritize their maintenance and departure schedules, ensuring maximum efficiency to save more lives.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Conscientious Dispatcher
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Ship scheduling is an art. Large vessels require clearing nearby docks of personnel and small craft to avoid thermal hazards. Thanks to rigorous training and dedication, [PAWN_nameDef]'s watch has never seen accidents - a record likely to continue.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Cross-Department Coordinator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Who's the busiest in Navigation? Not pilots or dispatchers, but cross-department coordinators. Tasked with data exchange between Palace, Logistics, and Navigation divisions, [PAWN_nameDef]'s workload stuns even veteran staff. Colleagues often deliver warm milk - both admiring [PAWN_pronoun]'s dedication and worrying about [PAWN_pronoun]'s receding hairline.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Docking Controller
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Orderly docks create excellent first impressions, requiring experts like [PAWN_nameDef]. Regardless of traffic volume, [PAWN_nameDef] efficiently organizes every ship. For captains accustomed to congested lanes, [PAWN_pronoun]'s guidance is nothing short of divine.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·paceport Logistician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Every spaceport needs logisticians to track ship inventories and needs, preventing conflicts during layovers. Undoubtedly skilled, [PAWN_nameDef] extracts accurate requirements from impatient captains while gently guiding shy crew to report correct quantities. [PAWN_nameDef] sets the gold standard for the profession.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Supply Ship Archivist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: No one understands supply ship inventory better than [PAWN_nameDef]. For [PAWN_pronoun], cataloging supplies has become as natural as breathing.\n\nWhile others struggle with complex cargo classifications, [PAWN_nameDef] finishes one ship and moves to the next. Perhaps driven by the honor of supporting voyages, [PAWN_nameDef] has mastered and cherishes this duty.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Leisurely Route Planner
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Long ago, [PAWN_nameDef] was just a route planner in a quiet sector. Reviewing three or four routes daily left [PAWN_pronoun] ample leisure time - for someone of [PAWN_pronoun]'s skill, the work took less than an hour...\n\nThis ended when the Navigation Department transferred [PAWN_pronoun] across sectors. Since that day, leisure became history.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Route Surveyor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: While navigators approve final routes, [PAWN_nameDef] personally tests their feasibility.\n\nEven within the Navigation Department, this high-risk work attracts only the most honorable and devoted. Despite numerous close calls, [PAWN_nameDef] has never complained.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Stellar Embrace
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The Navigation Department isn't all analytical minds - attendants like [PAWN_nameDef] embody its romantic spirit.\n\nSome join for honor, others for duty - but [PAWN_nameDef] joined for pure love. Love for the void, for starscapes, ultimately compelling [PAWN_pronoun] to sail among [PAWN_pronoun]'s beloved constellations.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Dauntless Attendant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] personifies the Navigation Department's exploratory spirit. With courage to venture, composure in crisis, and gentleness when homebound, [PAWN_nameDef] epitomizes the ideal attendant.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Supply Ship Volunteer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s love spans star systems, asking nothing in return. This selfless devotion led [PAWN_pronoun] to volunteer aboard supply ships. After basic training, [PAWN_nameDef] now traverses interstellar routes, delivering sincere goodwill to frontier settlers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Route Liaison
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Route planning isn't arbitrary - especially vital supply lines result from court departments coordinating needs.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] gathers and relays these requirements, serving as both messenger and bridge between institutions.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Spaceport Coordinator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: No single person can manage a massive spaceport, even with AI assistance.\n\nAs one of the Navigation Department's finest, [PAWN_nameDef] earned this honorable role. The demanding position warrants complete dedication - which [PAWN_nameDef] gives unreservedly.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Seasoned Navigator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a veteran navigator. Having piloted through asteroid fields and contained vacuum breaches, [PAWN_pronoun] commands absolute trust. Crews rely on [PAWN_nameDef] as surely as sunrise - knowing tomorrow's voyage will be equally secure.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Pathfinding Navigator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
Within the Navigation Department, [PAWN_nameDef] shines like Polaris for astronomers.

When dangerous routes need verification, [PAWN_nameDef] is the unquestioned choice.

[PAWN_pronoun]'s skills dazzle equally when exploring hazardous sectors or making unauthorized (yet flawless) departures from docking bays.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Battle-Hardened Navigator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: When ships face danger, even well-trained Navigation Department crew may feel unease - but never [PAWN_nameDef].\n\nWhat others consider perilous malfunctions are just routine for [PAWN_nameDef]. Countless emergencies have tempered [PAWN_pronoun]'s will into unshakable steel... Though why [PAWN_pronoun] keeps encountering disasters is another story altogether.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Spaceport Coordinator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: While spaceport gravity systems and low-G environments seem novel at first, long-term residents eventually find them dull. This truth struck [PAWN_nameDef] hard. [PAWN_pronoun] believes if thoughts could punch, that navigation officer who recruited [PAWN_pronoun] for data work would've been beaten countless times in dreams.\n\nYet life continues. After complaining, [PAWN_nameDef] always picks up those endlessly criticized yet indispensable spaceport reports again.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Temporarily Stationed Assault
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] isn't part of the spaceport Assault team, but was temporarily assigned for an upcoming mission requiring rapid deployment.\n\nHaving spent most [PAWN_pronoun]'s life planetside, everything about the spaceport fascinates [PAWN_nameDef]. Even vacuum holds deadly allure - had the raiders not retrieved [PAWN_pronoun] wearing gravity belts during [PAWN_pronoun]'s accidental exposure.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Spaceport Assault Team Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
Spaceport Assault typically comprise space-born natives adapted to low/zero gravity.

As such, [PAWN_nameDef] particularly enjoys watching planetary raiders struggle during temporary assignments, especially when they accidentally drift into vacuum and need rescuing in [PAWN_pronoun]'s arms.

Beyond routine security, [PAWN_nameDef]'s team serves as rapid responders when planetary forces cannot react in time - missions they consistently complete successfully.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Shipboard Assault Team Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Most Assault find shipboard escort duty tedious - but not [PAWN_nameDef].\n\nThe vast starscape, novel low-G training environments, and ships' luxurious dining halls all captivate [PAWN_nameDef] beyond measure. To [PAWN_pronoun], if paradise had names, they would be those of great starships.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Spaceport Assault Commander
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Though nominally responsible for spaceport defense, [PAWN_nameDef] knows if enemies breach the护卫 fleet, [PAWN_pronoun]'s team likely won't turn the tide.\n\nThus [PAWN_nameDef] focuses daily on training [PAWN_pronoun]'s raiders to maintain combat efficiency in low gravity.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Miracle-Seeking Crew
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Have you imagined real Zerg swarms existing? Or creatures made of ice cream? These sci-fi concepts epitomize [PAWN_nameDef].\n\n"The universe is a miracle of miracles" - this quote from a novel perfectly summarizes [PAWN_nameDef]'s worldview. This thirst for wonders ultimately led [PAWN_pronoun] aboard Navigation ships, awaiting true cosmic marvels.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Ship's Duty Master
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: While labels rarely define people, [PAWN_nameDef] embodies [PAWN_pronoun]'s title so completely that it becomes highest praise rather than stereotype.\n\nWhere "Duty Master" might seem exaggerated for others, for [PAWN_nameDef] it simply describes [PAWN_pronoun]'s daily excellence.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Ship-Devoted Crew
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
Unlike those merely fulfilling duties, [PAWN_nameDef] genuinely loves [PAWN_pronoun]'s work. [PAWN_nameDef]'s bond with [PAWN_pronoun]'s ship defies description - perhaps best called unconditional devotion.

This passion makes [PAWN_nameDef]'s work impeccable, establishing [PAWN_pronoun] as one of the ship's most reliable hands.

If only [PAWN_pronoun] wouldn't keep calling the ship "[PAWN_pronoun]'s wife"...

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Celestial Augur
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Humans forever chase mysterious concepts - like [PAWN_nameDef]'s obsession with astromancy. Perhaps due to [PAWN_pronoun]'s environment, [PAWN_nameDef]'s stellar studies take alarmingly practical turns. This dedication gives [PAWN_pronoun]'s navigation officers headaches - they now instinctively ask "[PAWN_nameDef]'s location?" whenever stars behave unusually.\n\nLook - Ursa Major's blinking again outside the viewport.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Ship's Polymath
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
Though [PAWN_nameDef] believes [PAWN_pronoun] would be researching cutting-edge theories in the Research Department if not for family traditions, everyone can see [PAWN_nameDef]'s true passion lies with Navigation Department ships.

[PAWN_nameDef] may make excuses or try to hide it, but the stack of spaceflight textbooks and novels by [PAWN_pronoun]'s bed speaks volumes.

Of course, [PAWN_nameDef] will likely never admit this - at least not verbally.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Veteran Mariner
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: If an excellent captain is a ship's soul, then veteran crew like [PAWN_nameDef] form its indispensable skeleton. The difference may not show in calm waters, but when true danger strikes, [PAWN_nameDef] consistently proves among the ship's most reliable hands.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·Crew of a Seafaring Dynasty
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The Navigation Department values heritage and honor, and as scion of a typical department family, [PAWN_nameDef]'s presence aboard its ships seems both natural and inevitable.\n\nThis inherited honor hasn't bred arrogance, but rather become the foundation for [PAWN_nameDef]'s rigorous self-discipline. To [PAWN_pronoun], honor is both reward and irrevocable duty.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The EVA Specialist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Even in the technologically advanced Oberonia Aurea Empire, extravehicular activity remains risky. Yet like most Navigation Department attendants, [PAWN_nameDef] considers this not a hazard to avoid, but a badge of honor and capability. During EVA operations, [PAWN_nameDef]'s small figure can always be glimpsed moving across the vast hull.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Ship's Engineer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: For interstellar vessels, accidents in the void are far deadlier than planetary maritime disasters. Where oceanic shipwrecks are dramatic tragedies, stellar mishaps become silent sighs.\n\nTo prevent such catastrophes, [PAWN_nameDef] maintains ships with meticulous care. Uneventful voyages may seem dull, but they beat terrifying odysseys.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Diligent Duty Officer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Data logging, instrument checks, course verification, spaceport communications... When hundreds of such tasks accumulate, even conscientious crew like [PAWN_nameDef] struggle. Yet though exhausted, [PAWN_nameDef] never considers quitting. Like [PAWN_pronoun]'s steadfast ship, [PAWN_nameDef] quietly upholds [PAWN_pronoun]'s duties.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Steady Hand
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s life follows predictable rhythms: rising, working, relaxing, and sleeping with clockwork regularity. This stability means [PAWN_nameDef] rarely delivers spectacular achievements - but also never causes headaches.\n\nFor a starship, uneventful competence is the greatest merit.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Star Sector Celebrity
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Even veteran crews' social circles rarely extend beyond their ships - but [PAWN_nameDef]'s connections seem improbably vast.\n\nNo one knows how [PAWN_pronoun] manages it, but [PAWN_nameDef] has made both [PAWN_pronoun]self and [PAWN_pronoun]'s ship famous throughout the sector. While the attention sometimes vexes crewmates, their colleagues' enthusiastic admiration transforms any annoyance into genuine pride.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Current Defier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: "Calm seas never made skilled sailors" has always been [PAWN_nameDef]'s creed. No danger can shake [PAWN_pronoun]'s resolve. To [PAWN_nameDef], peaceful voyages are merely dull obligations - only perilous journeys truly stir [PAWN_pronoun]'s soul.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Exact Technician
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: To crewmates, [PAWN_nameDef] isn't the easiest colleague during shifts. [PAWN_pronoun] strictly points out every mistake, even trivial ones, making coworkers feel tremendous pressure.\n\nYet after merciless criticism, [PAWN_nameDef] is always first to help fix errors. To [PAWN_pronoun], solving and preventing mistakes matters far more than assigning blame.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Romantic Voyager
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: To [PAWN_nameDef], voyages aren't mere point-to-point travel, but the wonders witnessed along the way.\n\nWhether stellar spectacles or ice giants' dreamlike beauty, these sights entrance [PAWN_nameDef]. Strict training produces competent spacers, but only love for the cosmos births true navigators.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Viewport Observer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
Like most Navigation Department attendants, [PAWN_nameDef] loves the starry void - but unlike them, [PAWN_pronoun] lacks courage to venture outside.

This hesitation keeps [PAWN_nameDef] watching through viewports as colleagues conduct EVAs, returning to work after silent envy.

Perhaps someday [PAWN_nameDef] will cross that threshold to embrace what [PAWN_pronoun] loves. This moment may come far in the future - or perhaps tomorrow.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Chronicler of Voyage Logs
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Though most voyage logs in the interstellar age can be automatically backed up through data recording, many Navigation Department attendants still maintain the habit of handwritten logs.\n\nTo [PAWN_nameDef], voyage logs are not mere records but affirmations of honor and self-worth. Each page's ink-black handwriting captures not just information, but the essence of every past struggle.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Lucky Star of Voyages
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Navigation Department attendants require not just exceptional skills, steadfast resolve, and rational judgment—but also something far more elusive: luck.\n\nAs someone recognized since childhood as a lucky charm, [PAWN_nameDef] was warmly welcomed by every navigation officer upon joining the department. No one can explain why, but wherever [PAWN_nameDef] goes, good fortune follows.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Night Shift Crew
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: A ship does not stop its journey for human schedules—thus, night shift crew are indispensable.\n\nAs a night shift worker, [PAWN_nameDef]'s duties differ little from regular crew, yet the pressure is amplified by disrupted circadian rhythms. Especially after a colleague began showing signs of sleepwalking, this already demanding role gained an extra layer of headache-inducing—yet oddly amusing—responsibility.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Dream Voyager
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once believed [PAWN_pronoun]'s crew career was stable yet unremarkable—until the night [PAWN_pronoun] sleepwalked and altered the ship's course, causing an unintended detour.\n\nSince that day, [PAWN_nameDef]'s visibility skyrocketed. Perhaps [PAWN_pronoun]'s career remains steady, but [PAWN_pronoun] will never again fade into the background as before.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Rescuer Among Stars
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
In the vast, desolate sea of stars, a ship's malfunction often spells doom for its entire crew—yet selfless beings like [PAWN_nameDef] fundamentally change this bleak reality.

No matter the star sector or shipping lane, whenever a distress signal appears, [PAWN_nameDef] will inevitably arrive in a rescue craft.

"No one should be abandoned. Not by unavoidable disasters, nor by sleepwalking-induced mishaps," [PAWN_nameDef] declares.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Crew on Leave
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Though drawn to the stars, endless voyages would break any Navigation Department attendant's spirit. Thus, each receives brief leave after completing a journey—and [PAWN_nameDef] is currently on such respite. To unwind, [PAWN_pronoun] chose to visit this long-heard-of but never-before-seen star system, hoping for fresh experiences.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Free-Spirited Crew
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
In the honor-driven Navigation Department, most diligently fulfill assigned roles to prove their worth—but [PAWN_nameDef] is an exception.

A free-spirited attendant, [PAWN_nameDef]'s concept of freedom differs from laziness, yet [PAWN_pronoun] resists taking orders.

Thus, [PAWN_nameDef] is usually permitted to contribute freely through [PAWN_pronoun]'s skills—and fortunately, [PAWN_pronoun] has never betrayed this trust.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Stellar Exploration Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
Interstellar navigation is arduous, skill-intensive work. For most citizens without specialized training, becoming crew would be impossible.

Thus, though not formally joining the court, [PAWN_nameDef] enrolled in the Navigation Department's training program. While less exciting than imagined, [PAWN_nameDef] persists in learning.

After all, stars begin as embers, and seeds slumber in dust.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Starfarer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Not everyone wishes to join the rule-bound Navigation Department—[PAWN_nameDef] prefers private ships.\n\nAboard these vessels, [PAWN_nameDef] often provides navigation assistance as an equal, but mostly [PAWN_pronoun] simply admires the journey's vistas. For [PAWN_nameDef] sails not for fame or profit, but for pure love of the stars.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Merchant Crew
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Though the Navigation Department manages imperial resource flows, finer details and interplanetary specialty trades still rely on private merchant crews like [PAWN_nameDef].\n\nMost such crew work less for payment than to share their homeworld's specialties with other planets. It's these simple, sincere acts of goodwill that unite the Oberonia Aurea Empire across stellar distances—preventing fragmentation into chaotic isolation.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Glorious Captain
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] was destined for greatness from birth. Thanks to a family tradition blending the Navigation Department and Farstrider culture, [PAWN_nameDef] displayed extraordinary courage and an insatiable thirst for exploration and progress from a young age.

Upon reaching adulthood, drawing from childhood experiences learning navigation skills from [PAWN_nameDef]'s father and a natural talent for sailing evident in youth, [PAWN_nameDef] officially received a notice from the Navigation Department on [PAWN_pronoun]'s coming-of-age day, seamlessly becoming an honorary route explorer outside the department's formal roster.

Now, [PAWN_nameDef] is planning a new expedition. For an outstanding captain, only a thrilling adventure is worthy of the honor [PAWN_pronoun] deserves.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Loyal Crew Member
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s mind was always filled with tales of heroism, driving [PAWN_pronoun] to constantly improve [PAWN_pronoun]self in hopes of being noticed and invited to participate in legendary stories one day.\n\nFortunately, [PAWN_nameDef] eventually met the captain worthy of [PAWN_pronoun]'s lifelong devotion.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Alien Photographer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] loves capturing eternal memories through photographs. To document vanishing landscapes, [PAWN_nameDef] is always transferring to new ships at spaceports, unwilling to waste any time. After all, [PAWN_pronoun] has plenty of time, but those lost scenes can never be recovered.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Navigator of Cotton Candy Star
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood was spent immersed in one fairy tale after another. If asked which story [PAWN_pronoun] loved most, it would undoubtedly be the tale of the cotton candy planet.

As time passed, [PAWN_nameDef] gradually understood the nature of fairy tales. Unlike most, however, [PAWN_pronoun] grew even fonder of that story and vowed to find the planet as sweet as cotton candy.

Though [PAWN_nameDef] has yet to discover that planet, the genuine joy and sweetness [PAWN_pronoun] feels with each new planetary discovery is undeniable. Perhaps the cotton candy planet doesn't exist in the universe—or perhaps [PAWN_nameDef] has already found the "cotton candy planet" in [PAWN_pronoun]'s heart.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Gliding Explorer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
In most people's minds, exploration is limited to the ground, but aerial explorers like [PAWN_nameDef] shatter that notion.

[PAWN_nameDef] is no conventional Farstrider. On the contrary, [PAWN_pronoun] specializes in unique exploration techniques, with paragliding being the most iconic.

When soaring through the sky, facing the unknown terrain below, [PAWN_nameDef] truly embodies the spirit of exploration—not through routine or steady progress, but through the courage to land in the unknown time and again, always standing tall.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Farstrider of Alien Worlds
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dislikes re-exploring the known, preferring the pure thrill of the unknown. Thus, [PAWN_pronoun] is always venturing to newly discovered planets. The next expedition may be perilous, but to [PAWN_nameDef], that's the true joy of exploration.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Spaceborne Farstrider
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description:
Though a Farstrider, as a native of spaceports, [PAWN_nameDef] differs slightly from [PAWN_pronoun]'s peers.

Whether in depth of thought, understanding of space, or caution and awareness of alien worlds, [PAWN_nameDef] often stands out among [PAWN_pronoun]'s kind.

Of course, [PAWN_nameDef] also excels in one other area: an acute discomfort with planetary gravity.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Diligent Citizen of Spaceports
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: One's environment shapes their thoughts and logic, and [PAWN_nameDef] is living proof of this theory.\n\nAs a native of spaceports, [PAWN_nameDef]'s daily life starkly contrasts with other Oberonia Aurea citizens. Thanks to the convenience and bustling trade of spaceports, [PAWN_nameDef] encounters something new almost every day. This life of constant surprises keeps [PAWN_pronoun] motivated and endlessly inspired, making [PAWN_nameDef] a vital link in cultural dissemination and a minor celebrity in artistic creation.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Artisan of Space
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Stone? Carving material. Meteorite? Carving material. Precious meteorite specimen? Still carving material. [PAWN_nameDef] is so consumed by [PAWN_pronoun]'s artistic pursuits that even a neutron star might just be a currently unusable carving treasure in [PAWN_pronoun]'s eyes.\n\nThis fervent, pure artistic drive has made [PAWN_nameDef] a renowned master sculptor—but also the Research Department's archnemesis, especially when that rare meteorite fragment from an unknown star system lands on [PAWN_pronoun]'s carving table.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·The Little Shopkeeper of Spaceports
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Life in spaceports may have its inconveniences, but their unparalleled frequency of goods exchange makes up for it—especially for small shop owners like [PAWN_nameDef].\n\nBy trading with merchant ships from all star sectors, [PAWN_nameDef] always stocks [PAWN_pronoun]'s little shop with unique and novel items. While most transactions are routine, if a curious customer asks about an item's origin or cultural significance, [PAWN_nameDef] won't hesitate to explain for half an hour.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·OA·The Calculating Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: A long time ago, [PAWN_nameDef] was not so sensitive to numbers. However, ever since [PAWN_possessive] parents, before leaving on a long journey, failed to leave enough food for the young [PAWN_pronoun] due to a miscalculation, which directly led to [PAWN_nameDef] having to survive by eating the domesticated gold iris plants, [PAWN_pronoun] has never trusted anyone else's calculations again.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: OA·OA·The Unerring Coordinator
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is, by any measure, an exceptional coordinator, particularly due to [PAWN_possessive] utter intolerance for vague and inaccurate data.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] has a profound understanding of the duties of the Coordination Department. [PAWN_pronoun] knows that every piece of data corresponds to a link in the empire's administrative chain, and any negligence could lead to a disaster. Therefore, [PAWN_pronoun] always meticulously verifies every piece of data and has never made an error.
